text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Electoral Commission Chair Anastazia Msosa has contradicted a claim by commission press officer Morgan Mayani that an audit report that unveiled misappropriation of 15 million kwacha ($1-million) was discussed.
- Police have arrested a fellow officer after suspecting him of having burnt five vehicles last Friday when he tried to siphon fuel from one of the vehicles and was scorched in the raging fire.

- The newly formed United Council for Dialogue (UCD), comprising nine political parties outside parliament, has rejected beliefs that inflation drops or World Bank sponsored borrowing rates reflect the real economic situation of the country.
- Negotiations between university lecturers and government over demands for a 100 per cent salary increase have stalled after the two sides reached no compromise.
